asset_id.description: A video asset with audio, or an audio asset, that was transcribed.

from_word.description: Index of the first word to remove, in the transcript of the asset.

new_ids.description: Ids for the new pieces, in order of cut.

snap.description: A length, 0 to 2s; the farthest an edge of the cut may move into a silence beside it. Default "0.3s"; "0s" cuts at the word times.

to_word.description: Index of the last word to remove, inclusive.
